cards.text: Amos, a sheepherder from Tekoa, has been bringing the LORD's words of judgment on nation after nation: Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, the Ammonites, Moab and even Judah (Amos 1:1-2:5). Now the LORD says that for three transgressions of Israel, even four, He will not revoke His judgment. I bet Israel didn't see their OWN name coming.

cards.question: The LORD's first charge is that Israel sells the righteous for silver. What do they sell the needy for?

cards.text: Then the LORD says they trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth, and they push the needy out of their way.
Then the LORD names something else they do. A man and his father have relations with the same girl.

cards.question: The LORD says what a man and his father do with the same girl profanes His holy name.

cards.text: And the LORD keeps going. They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge.

cards.question: In the house of their God, Israel drinks wine obtained through ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD brings up the Amorite, a people of Canaan, tall like the cedars and as strong as the oaks. Friend, I'm a cookie stamper, and some days I LOSE a wrestling match with an oven mitt.

cards.question: Israel beat the Amorite because Israel's men were even taller and stronger.

cards.text: The LORD says it was He who destroyed the Amorite, his fruit above and his roots below.

cards.question: The LORD also reminds Israel of the land He brought them up from. Which land was it?
The LORD led Israel forty years in the wilderness so they might take possession of the land of the ___.

cards.text: He also raised up prophets from their sons and Nazirites from their young men. Then the LORD asks, "Is this not true, O children of Israel?"

cards.question: Israel lets the prophets the LORD raised up keep prophesying.

cards.text: Instead, they made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

Ordering the prophets to stop prophesying is like yanking the battery out of the smoke detector: the beeping stops, but the smoke doesn't. Then the LORD says, "Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain."

cards.question: Israel has swift runners, strong men and mighty warriors. When the LORD crushes them, what does He say will fail the swift?
When the LORD crushes Israel, the horseman will at least save his life.
What does the LORD say even the bravest of mighty men will do on that day?
